summary: Tested the tiered Recruiter program (backend + UI) and the Available Jobs board for providers. Backend: 15 API tests, 14 passed, plus 1 credit_referrer unit test against local Mongo, which passed. Rates step correctly 0.1 -> 0.11 at 1000 prior jobs, gross = provider_amount/0.9, rate_pct and gross_amount are stored, the cap at 0.99 works, and tier_info is correct. Frontend: /recruiter works logged out (ladder-0..5000, signup CTA) and logged in (ReferralCard + recruiter-tier, rate 0.10%, next 0.11%). /wallet shows recruiter-tier. Admin Recruiters tab saves and persists config, shows the backend error toast for invalid values and renders the leaderboard (4 rows). /available-jobs defaults to the deliveries filter (handyman job hidden, shown under 'All jobs'). Accept goes to /jobs/{id}/track with a success toast. The empty state shows, and a customer visiting the page is redirected to /. The ProviderHub links and the footer recruiter link are present. Recruiter config was restored to defaults (0.1/0.01/1000/0.99) and verified.

minor.issue: A non-numeric value (e.g. base_pct='abc') returns 500. float()/int() raise ValueError and nothing catches it. It should return 400/422. Use a Pydantic model with Field(ge=0, lt=1) instead of a raw dict.
No check that base_pct <= max_pct. step_jobs=1.5 is silently cut to 1 by int().

ui_bugs.issue: Clearing an input and pressing Save sends Number('')=0, so the backend saves base_pct=0 with a success toast (reproduced). An admin can zero the recruiter rate by accident. Block empty values on the client.

issues: When the list is short, the footer stops above the bottom of the viewport and leaves a white band below it at 1920x1080. Use a min-h-screen/flex layout.

action_items: Validate the PUT /referrals/admin/program body with a Pydantic model so bad input returns 400/422 instead of 500, and enforce base_pct <= max_pct
In RecruitersTab, block Save when a field is empty or not a number
Update the stale referrals.py docstrings ('1% of commission', 'amount/900', PROVIDER_TAKE_TO_REFERRER_RATIO is unused) to describe the tiered program
critical_code_review_comments: The tier is counted from db.referral_earnings.count_documents, so every payout event counts as one 'recruit job'. A job paid in two parts (deposit + final, or escrow release) would count twice. Check that this matches the business meaning of 'jobs completed'.
credit_referrer counts then inserts without atomicity, so concurrent payouts can use the same rate. This only matters at the boundary and is acceptable.
The leaderboard runs 2 queries per row (N+1). Fine for 100 rows.
accept_job uses get_current_user rather than require_role('provider'). It was not changed in this iteration, but a non-provider can call it.
The admin tab trigger testid is 'admin-tab-recruiters'; 'admin-recruiters-tab' is on the tab content container.

success_rate.backend: 94% (15/16 incl. unit test; the one failure is the minor 500 on non-numeric input)
